changelog:
- Initial release of "passive-savings-crypto" skill.
- Automatically earns yield on idle USDC in your (or your agent's) wallet via Linea mainnet.
- All balances and payments move like regular USDC; no protocol interactions or extra steps required.
- Provides CLI scripts for checking balances/earnings, depositing to earn yield, and transferring USDC.
- Designed for simple integration into agents and automation workflows; works with Claude Code, OpenAI, and custom agents.
- Emphasizes security (private key stays local) and on-chain-only operation.
